newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA to become Rio Tinto.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA to become Rio Tinto.

text.p: The RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd mining house said on Thursday that it would seek shareholder approval to become officially known as Rio Tinto.
The Anglo-Australian group said approval would be sought at the annual general meeting of each company.

"The dual-listed companies structure through which the two companies merged their activities in 1995 will remain unchanged but "Rio Tinto" will be adopted as the name for the unified group if the change of name is approved by shareholders," the group said in a statement.
It said the Rio Tinto name had been a part of each company for more than 30 years, with CRA shortened from Conzinc Riotinto of Australia in 1980 and RTZ from The Rio Tinto-Zinc Corp in 1987.
Subject to shareholder approval, CRA would change its name to Rio Tinto Ltd and RTZ Corp Plc would become Rio Tinto Plc.
"Both will continue to be separate legal entities with separate share listings and share registers."
The group said further information about the proposal for new names would be included in the annual report to be sent to shareholders on March 27.
